findings.title: Proposed Pricing Adjustment
findings.rationale: The contract outlines a proposed pricing adjustment reflecting inflation and service enhancements, indicating a structured pricing approach.
evidence_excerpts: Pricing adjustment: 5–7% increase reflecting inflation, supply chain escalation, and service enhancement investments.
